records.description_rewritten: Davaki Square (Plateía Daváki) is a municipal square in Kallithea, southwest of central Athens. Its original cruising-directory description concerns a toilet near a main park entrance, but gives no operator-verified restroom layout or hours. A March 2026 country-feed post solicits a meeting but does not report an encounter; the direct listing has only one blank March 2025 comment. Kallithea municipal security contracts and a contractor's record confirm organised late-evening square patrols historically, meaning this should not be presented as an unrestricted private setting.
records.location_identity: Plateía Daváki in Kallithea municipality (not central Athens); exact toilet placement and which adjoining park entrance source means unverified.
records.access_conditions: Active municipal square with visitors, public infrastructure and night security patrols reported in 2021–22 sources (not proof the identical security contract continues in November 2026). Toilet hours unknown, and public restroom use must respect privacy and consent.

records.description_rewritten: Limanakia A is the first of a chain of rocky swimming inlets below Poseidonos Avenue between Vouliagmeni and Varkiza. The cruising directory uses 'Limanakia A' for the first bus-stop approach and claims activity on rocky ledges. A December 26, 2025 contributor calls it active by day and late evening—recent anecdotal evidence but an unspecific description rather than a verified firsthand sexual encounter. Limanakia B, around 600 metres away in the same directory, has stronger independent gay-nude-beach recognition. These two shoreline entries should not be merged just because their names are similar.
records.location_identity: Limanakia A coastal bus stop and rocky cove, Vouliagmeni–Varkiza, southeastern Attica; separate from adjacent B indexed #523.
records.access_conditions: Steep unmaintained rocky trail from EO91/Poseidonos road with limited facilities, deep water and occasional slippery ledges. Bus stop and road verge access does not imply safe parking or private sexual conduct. Bring adequate water and use daylight routes rather than unlit descent.

records.description_rewritten: Igroviotopos Alikis translates as the Alykes wetland on Kos, a former salt pan behind Tigaki between Tigaki and Marmari. The official tourism bureau identifies it as a Natura 2000 ecological habitat with reeds, migratory birds and flamingos, and as a place to view nature from established public routes. The directory categorises it as a possible cruising natural area, but the original detailed page was inaccessible and no dated firsthand meetings could be verified. Its protected shores are not an unrestricted night playground.
records.location_identity: Alykes/Tigaki Salt Lake wetland near Tigaki–Marmari on the island of Kos. No precise shoreline, salt-pan or park spot from original directory identified.
records.access_conditions: Designated Natura 2000 migratory bird and nesting habitat; stay on public paths and avoid entering protected mudflats, reeds or disturbing birds. Seasonally dries, so apparent salt-crusted ground may still be unstable; official tourism confirms foot/cycle access outside sensitive cores.

records.description_rewritten: Paradise Beach on Kos is the lively sandy beach of Kefalos Bay, known for shallow water, watersports, sunbeds and families. The source directory unexpectedly calls it 'Paradise Beach (nudist beach)', but the official island tourism entry depicts a family-oriented serviced beach, while a detailed beach directory explicitly calls its main organised section not naturist-friendly. It is possible that the contributor meant a quieter undeveloped neighbouring stretch rather than the main beach; without an accessible original page or pin this cannot be determined. No recent actual cruising encounter reports are verified.
records.location_identity: Paradise Beach in Kefalos Bay on Kos, not similarly named Paradise Beach on Mykonos. Source naturist designation might concern an unmarked fringe section, not identified.
records.access_conditions: Organised public family beach with commercial sunbeds, cafe and watersports. Nudism not officially confirmed for main busy shore; follow beach concessions, lifeguard and other visitors' expectations, avoid treating families and workers as willing participants.
